title: Crestline Fleet Account Discount Rate Card
content:
Every Crestline Fleet Account takes a fleet discount off the store's posted price, set per service category by the program the account is on. The rates below are percents.

| Service category | Crestline Fleet Starter | Crestline Fleet Business | Crestline Fleet Commercial | Crestline Fleet National | Crestline Fleet Enterprise | Crestline Fleet Public Sector |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tires | 5 | 8 | 10 | 12 | 15 | 12 |
| Alignment | 5 | 10 | 12 | 15 | 18 | 15 |
| Brakes | 5 | 10 | 12 | 15 | 18 | 15 |
| Battery | 0 | 5 | 8 | 10 | 12 | 10 |
| Maintenance | 5 | 10 | 12 | 15 | 18 | 15 |
| Repair | 5 | 8 | 10 | 12 | 15 | 12 |
| Mobile service call | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Items the discount never applies to

On every program the fleet discount never applies to these ticket items: disposal fees, road hazard certificates, shop supplies, and sales tax.

## Rounding of the discount

On every program the discount amount on an invoice is rounded half up to the cent.

## National fleet price file

| Program | Tire prices before the discount come from |
|---|---|
| Crestline Fleet Starter | the store's posted price |
| Crestline Fleet Business | the store's posted price |
| Crestline Fleet Commercial | the store's posted price |
| Crestline Fleet National | the Crestline national fleet price file |
| Crestline Fleet Enterprise | the Crestline national fleet price file |
| Crestline Fleet Public Sector | the Crestline national fleet price file |

## Illustration (hypothetical figures)

A hypothetical alignment ticket on a Crestline Fleet Business account with a posted price of 89.95 takes the Business alignment rate of 10 percent: 10 percent of 89.95 is 8.995, which rounds half up to a discount of 9.00. A rate of 0 means no fleet discount in that category, as for battery work on Crestline Fleet Starter and for a mobile service call on every program.
